predictor_manifest.features: qf[0:12], dqf[0:12], H0 filtered acc/omega/alpha; standardize then IMU scale0.5
predictor_manifest.target_contract: acc/alpha left interval samples h-6,h-4,h-2ms; omega/rpy endpoint h
predictor_manifest.filter_caveat: Future FILTERED estimates, not raw instantaneous acceleration. No fixed time advance or delay compensation.
predictor_manifest.alpha_contract: 15Hz causal lowpass of backward difference of 15Hz filtered omega on 2ms grid
predictor_manifest.innovation: weighted historical future + decay[h,group]*(current - weighted historical current)
predictor_manifest.rotation_adapter: Measured node0 R; world-left SO3 exponential integration of trapezoidal predicted omega. RPY forecasts diagnostic only.
predictor_manifest.frame: fixed H0 yaw reference per run; torso IMU origin; gravity [0,0,-9.81]
predictor_manifest.status: Offline-fitted candidate; no claim of hardware MPC or raw-impact validation.

preflight.limitations: offline compatibility only; not a 6 ms field or closed-loop performance certificate
